digest.component_or_area: rebar CLI explain / packaged author guides
propositions: Guides served by rebar explain contain internal cross-references as consumer-relative paths that dangle for clients without a rebar checkout.
The rebar-ticket commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no CLI-discoverable home except verify-commit-ticket --help.
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md is registered as the commit-trailer topic in AUTHOR_GUIDES and served offline via rebar explain and the MCP explain_guide tool.
Dangling references in packaged guides are repointed to sibling rebar explain topics or canonical hosted github URLs so they resolve for repo-less consumers.

A link-resolution guard test asserts no packaged guide link target is consumer-relative, allowing only https/http/#anchor/mailto, and that every cited rebar explain topic names a real registered guide.
The MCP explain_criterion docstring must name commit-trailer, guarded so its guide list cannot drift from AUTHOR_GUIDES.
